guards.guard: a shadda is never transparent to the skeleton: a geminated radical occupies exactly ONE written letter position, never two
a GEM slot matches the written letter exactly like an ordinary radical slot; the doubling itself is a SEPARATE licence checked only after the shape has matched
the licence requires an EXACT declared environment: bound slot/radical, a written (never assumed) shadda source, non-jussive mood, and word-internal (never cross-boundary) merger
the jussive's un-geminated realization of the same root is a DIFFERENT written form this pack does not cover; it is never derived from the geminated one
triliteral doubling/gemination and quadriliteral templates are DISTINCT families and never collide by construction
method transfers, conclusions do not; per-token doubling needs per-token evidence
